text:
lina: scheduling NorthGrove dedicated rollout for Tue 2026-06-09 02:00 UTC. change window 45m. pin runtime v2.14.3 and model alexa-7b-q4f. need go/no-go and KMS ack. 

deploybot: job created: deploy-job-4572 targeting northgrove-dedicated; canary slice = 5% traffic for 10m, rollback threshold = error rate > 3% or p95 latency increase > 40%. auto-fallback to alexa-7b-fp16 if resource shortage. 

sam: ack from infra — GPU pool reserved (pool-id: gpupool-north-02). will patch node-drain script to preserve KV cache. :thumbsup: 

jessica: Security confirms KMS rotation doesn't collide with that window. KMS key NG-Dedicated-01 set to Retain mode, no rotation planned next 30d. 

kevin_o: quick note — telemetry agent version must be 1.7.1 on those instances or we lose request tracing. i'll coordinate a preflight upgrade 6h before window. 

lina: thanks, kevin. sam — can you add the `preserve_kv=true` flag in the rollout job? we saw cache misses last time. 

sam: done. rollout config snippet: ```json
{
  "canary_percent": 5,
  "canary_duration": "10m",
  "preserve_kv": true,
  "fallback_model": "alexa-7b-fp16"
}
``` 

ops_oncall: monitoring runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ng-dedicated-rollout. Pager thresholds set, grafana dashboard: infra/ng/northgrove-dedicated. I'll be on-call during the window. 

jessica: FYI legal requested redaction of customer metadata in logs — we will keep full logs in vault and only redacted metrics to external dashboards. already added to release notes. 

lina: can we get a green from product and support for customer-notify copy? sending draft: "Planned maintenance: brief service adjustment; expected continuity with fallback. No action required." 

kevin_o: product ok with that language. support signed off on the notify timeline (30m pre-window). 

sam: final checklist done, all preflight checks pass. 

deploybot: deploy-job-4572 staging -> canary scheduled at 2026-06-09T02:00:00Z. status: queued. To cancel run: `/deploy cancel 4572`. 

lina: go/no-go? please react with :thumbsup: to approve or comment if blockers. 

jessica: :thumbsup: 

sam: :thumbsup: will watch KV metrics closely. 

kevin_o: :thumbsup: 

ops_oncall: :thumbsup: oncall present. 

lina: rolling ahead then. I will post a short postmortem template link in thread after the window. Thanks everyone.
